system.description: You take on an air of arrogance, allowing you to distract and sway others with your apparent knowledge and experience. When you make a successful Persuasion check to change an enemy's Attitude, the enemy takes a -5 penalty to its Will Defense until the end of your next turn. If you spend a Force Point, the duration is extended to the end of the encounter. This is a Mind-Affecting effect.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions
